title: Irish Oat Pudding
description: A delicious and comforting dessert made with oatmeal, Irish cream, and topped with a silky pudding.

ingredients.name: silk
ingredients.notes: or substitute with a non-dairy milk alternative

ingredients.name: knockout
ingredients.notes: or substitute with a strong brewed coffee

instructions: In a medium saucepan, bring 2 cups of water to a boil.
Add 1 cup of oatmeal and reduce heat to medium.
Cook, stirring occasionally, until the oatmeal has absorbed most of the water and has a creamy consistency.
In a separate bowl, whisk together 1/2 cup of Irish cream, 1/4 cup of silk, and 1/2 teaspoon of knockout.
Add 1 tablespoon of sugar, 2 tablespoons of butter, and 1/4 teaspoon of vanilla extract to the bowl and whisk until well combined.
Pour the cream mixture over the cooked oatmeal and stir until well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a serving dish and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
If desired, top with additional silk or whipped cream.
